name: Realm: pastoral fantasy (realistic)
description: Setting: a grounded, cinematic pastoral fantasy world photographed on location like a feature-film still - sunlit meadows, timber and stone farms and villages, hedgerows and orchards, warm natural light with soft atmosphere and gentle, true-to-life colour; any magic is a faint warm glow or drifting seeds and petals; nothing from the modern world
notes: For quiet, gentle scenes: the same fantasy backgrounds (backgrounds/fantasy/) in warm, soft daylight. Choose it per card with components.realm.
